title: ADR-004: ModelGateway and LiteLLM
summary: docs/adr/ADR-004-model-gateway-litellm.md · 原文保留历史日期；先学主课程，需要核查时再读。
html:
Status: Accepted in M0.

Provider differences are hidden behind ModelGateway. LiteLLM will be used by a later adapter for provider normalization, retry/fallback and usage/cost reporting. Business code will not import provider SDK types.
